Your dog's annual visit should include more than vaccines, especially after age 7. Bloodwork can show changes in kidney and liver function, blood sugar, and other markers before symptoms appear. Each year's results also give your vet a baseline to compare against as your dog ages. Our senior wellness panel is $129 and fits into the yearly checkup.
